name: boardrepo
description: Search and review real PCB projects with BoardRepo. Inspect schematic connectivity, BOMs and source files, run KiCad checks, compare fabrication limits, and review boards you own.

interface.longDescription: Answer hardware questions from real BoardRepo projects: search published designs, inspect actual schematic connectivity, BOMs and files, run KiCad DRC/ERC and fabrication checks, and review boards you own.
defaultPrompt: Find a published nRF54L15 board and explain its power circuit from the schematic.
Check whether this BoardRepo board passes KiCad DRC/ERC and a compatible fab profile.
Review my BoardRepo board, verify each finding, and report what was not checked.
